items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: No, all the rest of them from Baton Rouge and then, they had a boy from up around Mississippi. I don't know, I was the only one from him. Old Baton Rouge boy.

ctx.x: Any new orange guys in there besides you? All new orange guys?
No, all the rest of them from Baton Rouge and then, they had a boy from up around Mississippi. I don't know, I was the only one from him. Old Baton Rouge boy.
